title: Cosmetic unlocks MVP — 5 achievement-driven accessory unlocks on top of the persistent profile
intent: Profile foundation shipped S153; lifetime stat wires (self-death + chain detection) shipped S155. The next natural layer is COSMETIC UNLOCKS — achievement-style milestones that add accessories to the player's recipe pool. Five starter unlocks tied to existing stats: First Win, Survivalist (won 10 rounds), Chain Reactionist (triggered a 5-bomb chain), Pyromaniac (killed yourself with own bomb 5 times — self-aware reward), Veteran (50 rounds played). Each unlock adds ONE accessory to the player's accessory pool — when their recipe accessories field is unspecified, the random-default-picker picks from the unlocked pool. Players get visual progression that survives sessions. NO stats-on-cosmetics — unlocks are purely visual per the cosmetic-unlocks rule in `gdd.md`. Closes the long-promised session-depth feature without crossing into live-service territory.
rationale: Source: `docs/game-design/gdd.md Cosmetic unlocks (planned, MVP-3+)` + `characters-and-visual.md §6.3` (decided 2026-05-20: cosmetic unlocks committed but waiting for persistent profile). Profile foundation shipped S153, lifetime stats wired S155 — all dependencies met. Marked `should` because the user has been silently approving the session-depth direction (5 consecutive 'погнали дальше' without direction shift; dev independently extended profile work in S155 reinforcing the read). This is the headline unlock feature that gives lifetime stats their visible purpose.
acceptanceHints: Depends on: GDP-027-009 Profile (shipped S153) + S155 lifetime stat wires (chain detection + self-death). All dependencies in place.
PROFILE SCHEMA EXTENSION (examples/kaboom-crew/src/profile/profile-store.ts):

PlayerProfile gains `cosmeticUnlocks: string[]` (default []). Stored alongside existing lifetime stats. Schema bump to v2 with graceful fallback for v1 profiles (existing players keep their stats; cosmeticUnlocks initialised empty).
FIVE STARTER UNLOCKS (closed enum — no user-authoring):
'first-win'      → unlocks 'cap' accessory. Condition: lifetimeStats.matchesWon >= 1.
'survivalist'    → unlocks 'fins' accessory. Condition: lifetimeStats.roundsWon >= 10.
'chain-reactionist' → unlocks 'antennae' accessory. Condition: lifetimeStats.maxChainLength >= 5.
'pyromaniac'     → unlocks 'visor' accessory. Condition: lifetimeStats.deathsByOwnBomb >= 5. (Self-aware reward — the player gets a 'cool' accessory for repeatedly killing themselves.)
'veteran'        → unlocks 'backpack' accessory. Condition: lifetimeStats.roundsPlayed >= 50.
These five map exactly to the existing 5 accessory types from S106 (one accessory per unlock — no double-unlocks; no leftovers).
Unlock IDs are stable string keys (not numeric indices) — future unlocks won't shift indices.
UNLOCK CHECK SYSTEM (examples/kaboom-crew/src/profile/unlock-checker.ts):
Pure function `checkUnlocks(stats: LifetimeStats, currentUnlocks: string[]): { newlyUnlocked: string[], allUnlocked: string[] }`.
Called after each stat update (debounced to once per stat-write — already debounced in profile-store).
Returns newlyUnlocked subset (unlock IDs that crossed threshold THIS check) so the UI can show a banner.
UNLOCK BANNER:

When a newly-unlocked event fires: a centre-bottom HUD banner appears for 2.5s with the unlock's icon + label + accessory preview. Larger than pickup-tooltip (per GDP-027-005 Layer 2): ~120×120 px icon + 24px label 'UNLOCKED: Cap' + a 14px subtitle 'First match win'.
Banner fades in 0.20s, holds 2.0s, fades out 0.30s. Total 2.5s.
Banner colour: gold tint (HSL h=45, s=70%, l=60%) — distinct from per-bomber palette banners to signify 'meta-progression'.
Audio: new event `unlock-fanfare` — short rising chord (synth bell, 0.6s). Fires once per banner.
Voice synth: bomber's victory vocal slot (per GDP-022-008) fires on top of the fanfare. Layered audio polish.
RECIPE INTEGRATION:
CharacterRecipe's accessory random-default-picker (from S106) currently picks 0..3 from all 5 accessory types. Post this story: picks 0..3 from the UNLOCKED subset only.
Edge case: 0 unlocks → recipe.accessories defaults to []. Player starts with no accessories. First match → at least 'first-win' unlocks → cap available on next match restart.
URL recipe override: `?recipe=<base64>` with explicit accessories field bypasses the unlock filter (debug + agent use case, per characters-and-visual.md §6.2).
Recipe sharing: when a player shares their recipe via URL, accessories THEY chose are exposed even if recipient hasn't unlocked them. Sharing trumps unlocking (sharing is debug surface).
UNLOCKS PANEL (lightweight in-game UI):

Bench / kaboom main menu gains a small 'Unlocks' button → opens a panel showing all 5 unlock entries: icon + label + condition + LOCKED or UNLOCKED state. Locked entries show current progress (e.g. 'Survivalist: 7 / 10 rounds won').
Pure HTML overlay (same pattern as bench controls). 5 rows × 100px = ~500px panel.
Closes the gap 'what do I have to do?' — player can read all conditions at a glance.
MULTIPLAYER:

Profile is LOCAL only (per GDP-027-009 explicit non-goal: 'no server sync'). Cosmetic unlocks are LOCAL only too. Players in connected mode see THEIR OWN unlocks; the server doesn't validate unlocks — players who URL-share or have client-side recipe override accessories that weren't locally unlocked.
This is OK for v1 — cosmetic-only means there's no competitive advantage to faking unlocks. Anti-cheat is out of scope.
Future server-backed profile (deferred) would add validation; v1 trusts client.
AGENT PROBES:
`window.__agf.kaboom.getUnlocks()` — returns current cosmeticUnlocks array + the check thresholds (for testing).
`window.__agf.kaboom.forceUnlock(id)` — testing only; adds id to cosmeticUnlocks. (Documented as test-only; not for player use.)
`window.__agf.kaboom.resetUnlocks()` — clears cosmeticUnlocks for testing.
UNIT TESTS:
Fresh profile + first match-won → 'first-win' unlock fires once. Subsequent wins don't re-fire (no duplicate banner).
Threshold crossing detected exactly once: roundsWon 9→10 → 'survivalist' newlyUnlocked. roundsWon 10→11 → no new unlock.

Multiple unlocks simultaneously (rare but legal — e.g. a self-death triggers chain-reactionist + pyromaniac in same round): both fire newlyUnlocked, banners queue (one shows, then next after 0.3s fade-out).
Recipe default-picker post-unlock: with 2 unlocks → recipe picks 0..3 from the 2-item pool deterministically by seed.
Unlocks panel UI renders 5 rows with correct LOCKED / UNLOCKED state + progress for locked entries.
Schema v1 → v2 migration: existing profile gets cosmeticUnlocks=[] without losing other fields.
PLAYTEST QA BAR:
A new player completes their first match → sees 'UNLOCKED: Cap (First match win)' banner. Cap appears on their bomber next match.
After 10 rounds won → second banner fires; fins added to pool.
Player can open the Unlocks panel at any time and see what they still need to do.
No banners spam: rapid unlocks queue with 0.3s gap; no two banners overlap.
OUT OF SCOPE:
Server-side unlock validation (anti-cheat). v1 trusts client per cosmetic-only rule.
Unlock NOTIFICATIONS across sessions (e.g. push notification). Banner fires only on the moment the threshold crosses, in-session.
Unlock STACKING (multiple of same accessory variants — e.g. 'antennae+2'). v1 unlock = single accessory type.
Daily / weekly challenges. Battle pass. Live-service progression. Explicitly out per gdd.md.
Unlock TRADING between players. Out per gdd.md.
Cosmetic palette unlocks (unlock the 'jade' family). Stretch — accessory unlocks are the v1 scope; palette unlocks can be a follow-up after this lands.
Achievement-as-pure-flair (unlocks that grant NOTHING — just a badge). Five unlocks all grant accessory; pure flair would dilute the system.
